Hi, I'm Aniket.

Desi boy at heart. My first brush with scale was growing sugarcane; then somehow I ended up building software for millions of businesses at Razorpay. Turns out scale transfers.

These days, I lead the payments team at Constantinople, building AI-native banking systems for the world. I also build Reticket on the side, where fake tickets can't be listed.

I care about how a thing feels more than how it's supposed to be built. Whatever feels right to the eye is what ships.
